app.title: Journey Back to Krishna
card.gopal_admit.carry_one: Carry one with me. Just one.
card.gopal_fear_1.street: The whole street is counting with you.
card.gopal_fear_2.a_lot: Forty-one is a lot for one shop.
card.gopal_greet.why: Why not today? The fountain's dry.
controls.desktop.hum: Hold E with nothing near: you hum.
controls.desktop.look: Drag the mouse, either button held: look around.
controls.desktop.move: W A S D or the arrow keys: walk. Keep holding to run.
controls.desktop.places: Walk up to a shop door and press E to go in or out.
controls.desktop.use: E does whatever the button says when something is near. Esc pauses.
controls.desktop.walk_there: Click a spot on the ground: you walk there.
controls.gamepad.hum: Hold A with nothing near: you hum.
controls.gamepad.move: Left stick: walk. Push all the way and hold to run.
controls.gamepad.places: Walk up to a shop door and press A to go in or out.
controls.gamepad.use: A does whatever the button says when something is near. Start pauses.
controls.gamepad.walk_there: Walking there by tap is a touch thing; the sticks do the rest.
controls.title: How to play
controls.touch.hum: Hold that button with nothing near: you hum.
controls.touch.look: Right thumb, anywhere on the right: drag to look around.
controls.touch.move: Left thumb, anywhere on the left: drag to walk. Push all the way and hold to run.
controls.touch.places: Walk up to a shop door and tap the button to go in or out.
controls.touch.use: The button, lower right, does whatever it says when something is near.
controls.touch.walk_there: Tap a spot on the right: you walk there.
debug.title: Debug
end.line: The journey back begins again wherever you are.
journey.dawn.kept: You took the Veena from the tower and kept it.
journey.dawn.played: You played the Veena for the street at dawn.
journey.dry_fountain.gave: You carried a can to the fountain with Gopal Seth.
journey.dry_fountain.took: You took a can from Gopal Seth's shop.
journey.glimpse.traffic_light: You thought you saw someone on the traffic light.
line.carving_look: A name, cut deep into the brick years ago. Someone climbed here before the billboard went up.
line.fountain_look: It's dry. The shop beside it is full of water.
line.gopal_admit: I'm afraid, that's all. If it runs out, who do they blame?
line.gopal_after_give: Listen. You can hear it from here.
line.gopal_agree: One. I'll walk it with you. Don't tell the lorry.
line.gopal_decline: Come back tomorrow. Maybe I'll feel braver.
line.gopal_fear_1: The lorry didn't come Tuesday. Or Thursday. You start counting cans.
line.gopal_fear_2: Forty-one. I check. Every night I check.
line.gopal_greet: Water? I have water. Not for sale today, friend. Tomorrow, maybe.
line.gopal_hurt: I saw that. I'd have given it, if you'd asked.
line.storekeeper_greet: Looking for something? It's all on the shelves. Mostly.
line.storekeeper_water: Gopal has the cans. Ask him, if he's feeling brave.
line.tailor_greet: Come in, come in. Look around; nothing here bites.
line.tailor_who_made: My mother did. I only keep the thread from tangling.
line.veena_dawn: Wind. The Veena on its stand, and the whole street below, still grey.
line.veena_kept: You lift it from the stand and hold it to your chest. Nobody follows.
line.veena_played: Your hands find the strings. Far below, a boy's three notes finish.
now.boy_led: The boy went behind the chai stall.
pause.title: Paused
quest.dry_fountain.carry: One can. Walk it to the fountain with him.
quest.dry_fountain.hear: Gopal Seth has something he isn't saying.
quest.dry_fountain.notice: The fountain is dry. The shop beside it is full.
settings.tap_to_walk: Tap a spot to walk there
